objective: Fresh storefront cart and order eligibility across read/mutation/handoff, preserving persisted approved marketplace sales origin and independent buyer history/recovery.
acceptance: Prove actual mounted HTTP route behavior, persisted effects and mode/password/revocation changes before fixing
Storefront cart create/read/update/identity/discount/handoff and order-intent admission honor current store publication and visitor authority before data/business writes
Existing marketplace carts derive their origin from stored state, require current canonical approved listing authority, and cannot gain bypass from a client channel field
Already committed order recovery, buyer history and genuine payment reconciliation retain their independent capabilities and are not blanket denied by storefront navigation mode
Metadata admission must have a deliberately authoritative fresh path; owned Hyperdrive-shaped wire does not prove managed query-cache freshness
Appropriate positive/negative/dependency/recovery and browser integration, source manifest and additive report evidence
constraints: No new merge/push after completed machine handoff without renewed authorization
Preserve mobile/shared wire contracts and realm isolation
No weakening existing validators or migration guards
initialFinding: Cart and order routes resolve published store but do not themselves check access_mode; catalogue guard context is only set by catalogue paths. Actual effects must be reproduced before asserting exposure.
